serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Cloud Insights is a SaaS observability platform for on-premises, hybrid cloud and multi-cloud resources, for full-stack visibility across organizations’ IT ecosystems. Cloud Insights provides organizations a consolidated view of their entire infrastructure for capacity management and optimization, monitoring, advanced reporting and and performance/configuration troubleshooting.

Cloud Insights is used by organizations at all levels of scale and across a variety of different industries to deliver the following use cases:
- Visualizing performance and capacity across heterogeneous resources and infrastructure through customizable dashboards
- Optimization and waste reduction for storage and compute resources on-prem and in the cloud
- A consistent UI and operational workflows for organizations with workloads split between cloud on on-prem locations, and throughout cloud migrations
- In-depth observability for Kubernetes platform administrators with Pod-to-Storage mapping, a visual cluster explorer and correlation of metrics to logs 
- Suite of features for managing NetApp ONTAP storage 
- Intelligent insights to automatically identify potential performance issues and risks of capacity exhaustion and provide remedial actions to prevent outage or degradation
- Customizable BI reporting and data warehouse for chargeback, showback and capacity planning
